summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper: downloads Bun to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) runs an obfuscated launcher (hex identifiers, string-array rotation) that either invokes a locally installed Bun runtime or downloads the Bun binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods +x, and executes a bundled `math_init.js` (~728 KB) under that runtime. `math_init.js` is a `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle with hex-named identifiers and a string-array rotation loader — its contents cannot be audited from the tarball at rest. Neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` is listed in package.json's `files` allowlist, yet both ship in the tarball and are wired into `preinstall`. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` scope but `repository`, `homepage`, and author metadata point at `brainly/html-sketchapp`, indicating scope impersonation of an unrelated upstream. The stated purpose (HTML→Sketch converter) does not require an alternate language runtime, and the README does not mention any runtime download or the payload file. Installing this package causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to execute on the installer's host at `npm install` time via the fetched Bun binary running the obfuscated payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
